Apply the point to a familiar task. Carry the idea into your next decision. Notice which part of this you would use first on shift.

segments.narration: OMAR: Prevention is now covered: think of the patient in front of you who is due a screen. Move through the items one at a time and connect each point with a practical response. The aim is to use the information, not just recognise it. Link it to the task waiting for you tomorrow. If one detail stays with you, let it be the safe one. Ask early when a situation does not match the rule. Good habits here are quiet: check, confirm, continue. Pause and connect this to your role.
